title: docs: add Cursor Cloud specific instructions to AGENTS.md
body: ## Summary Adds a `## Cursor Cloud specific instructions` section to `AGENTS.md` documenting non-obvious gotchas discovered during cloud agent environment setup: - **Node 24 PATH override**: `/exec-daemon/node` (v22) shadows nvm's Node 24 binary. The update script prepends the correct path. - **Vercel Blob TLS block**: Despite allowlist in `sandbox.json`, TLS handshakes to `blob.vercel-storage.com` are reset. Documents which routes are affected. - **Testing strategy**: Guidance on which endpoints/pages are testable in cloud vs which require Blob connectivity. ## Evidence Dev server running on port 3000 — static and DB-backed routes working. ![Design system page](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-01d6d02c-7553-46a3-99d4-f255c53fac68) ![Upload page](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-aa51ac2c-0b65-4238-ba83-411e0e3ff659) ## Verification - `npm run lint` — passes clean - `npm run build` — compiles all routes successfully - `npm run dev` — serves on port 3000 - DB API endpoints respond correctly (Neon connection working)
